description: Check wallet balances across EVM, Cosmos, and Solana chains. Returns native token balances AND key ERC-20 token balances (USDC, USDT, WETH, WBTC, cbBTC, BTCB) by default. Uses multiple RPCs with automatic failover. Returns per-token balance, USD value (via CoinGecko), and total portfolio value. Call this before any bridging or farming operation to verify sufficient funds and gas.

chains.description: Chains to check (default: all). Options: ethereum, optimism, bsc, polygon, arbitrum, avalanche, base, linea, scroll, zksync, mantle, blast, persistence, solana

includeTokens.description: Include ERC-20 token balances (USDC, USDT, WETH, WBTC, cbBTC, BTCB). Default: true.

includeUsd.description: Include USD valuations for each balance (default: true). Uses CoinGecko prices, cached for 60s.

tokens.description: Custom tokens to check per chain, e.g. { "base": [{ "address": "0x...", "symbol": "FOO", "decimals": 18 }] }

name: wallet_balance
